#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  SHARED FAST GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL   ║
# ║  size ≤ 2800 lines · analyze · tests · coverage ≥ 80% · CRAP ratchet ·    ║
# ║  duplication < 1% (flutter_app < 3.7%) · cross-module < 0.31%             ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# THE shared fast gate used by BOTH the pre-commit hook and CI (issue #177,
# AC7). Both callers run this exact script and diff the one-line markers
#   GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>
# for hook/CI parity. Every known stage ALWAYS prints exactly one marker:
# OK when it ran and passed, SKIP <reason> when it was not selected or a
# required tool is missing. A failing stage aborts the script with exit 1
# BEFORE its OK marker is printed (marker absent = failed).
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh [--scope auto|all|core|app|docs] [--stages list] [--hook]
#
#   --scope auto  Derive the scope from changed paths (default):
#                 - in a git hook (--hook flag or GIT_INDEX_FILE set):
#                   staged files via `git diff --cached --name-only`;
#                 - in CI (BASE_REF + HEAD_REF env vars set):
#                   `git diff --name-only $BASE_REF...$HEAD_REF`;
#                 - otherwise: "all" (safe default).
#   --scope all   Run every stage.
#   --scope core  size + analyze + test-core + coverage + crap + dup + dupx.
#   --scope app   size + analyze + dup + dupx + flutter.
#   --scope docs  size + analyze only.
#   --stages l    Comma-separated stage list; overrides the scope-derived set.
#                 Known stages: size,analyze,test-core,coverage,crap,dup,dupx,flutter,integration-mock
#
#
# Path rules (union logic, E1; test/** counts as core, E6):
#   docs/ | *.md | prompts/ .................. size + analyze
#   lib/ | bin/ | test/ | pubspec.* .......... + test-core, coverage, crap, dup, dupx
#   test/integration/** ...................... + integration-mock (no-key legs,
#                                              MockLlmServer; issue #551)
#   flutter_app/ | packages/ ................. + dup, dupx, flutter
#   scripts/ | .github/ | crap4dart.yaml ..... ALL stages (safe default, E2)
#   anything unknown ......................... ALL stages (safe default)
#
# Concurrency overrides: FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY / FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY
# (auto-throttled via detect_test_concurrency, same as scripts/pre-commit).
# Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N makes the integration-mock
# stage rerun ONLY its failed files, up to N times, before failing — the
# load-sensitive PTY/grid timing legs stop costing a full 2.5 h leg per
# ambient flake (default 0 = single-shot, behaviour unchanged).
#
# CRAP ratchet scoping: in --hook mode the analyze runs over the STAGED
# lib/bin files only — the ratchet guards what a commit touches, so a
# pre-existing offender in an untouched file cannot block an unrelated
# commit. Non-hook runs (and ci.yml's whole-repo `crap4dart analyze`)
# keep the full-repo view, so nothing escapes the ratchet permanently.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Unset git env vars so test processes that spawn git subprocesses use the
# correct working directory rather than the hook's environment. The --hook
# scope detection below reads GIT_INDEX_FILE BEFORE this line runs.
SCOPE=auto
STAGES_OVERRIDE=""
HOOK_MODE=0
DRY_RUN=0
if [ "${GIT_INDEX_FILE:-}" ]; then HOOK_MODE=1; fi
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --scope) SCOPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --scope=*) SCOPE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --stages) STAGES_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --stages=*) STAGES_OVERRIDE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --hook) HOOK_MODE=1; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;   # print derived scope/stages, run nothing
    *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE 2>/dev/null || true

COVERAGE_BASELINE=80.0

- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T16:47:52Z

## PR Description

### What changed
Split the four god-files into `part`-based libraries (pure mechanical moves, zero behavior change) and closed the 2800-line guard hole that let two files sail past the ceiling:

| file | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `bin/fah.dart` | 2889 | 224 (+6 `bin/fah_*.dart` parts) |
| `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` | 2785 | 1954 (+4 `agent_cli_{lifecycle,input,pickers,run}.dart`) |
| `lib/src/tools/builtin_tools.dart` | 2797 | 178 (+8 `builtin_tools_<family>.dart` parts) |
| `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart` | 2896 | 1994 (+7 `agent_service_*` extension parts) |
| `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/wasm_shell.dart` | 2835 | 2728 (+1 part — pre-existing offender the new app guard exposed) |

### Key decisions
- **Parts, not packages**: every split uses the repo's established `part of` pattern so private identifiers and public signatures stay put — no API moves, no import churn. `bin/` command code stays in `bin/` (`dart:io` may not enter pure-Dart `lib/`).
- **Guard hole (AC2)**: ci.yml's size guard scanned only `lib test example`; it now scans `bin` too, and a new `flutter_app/lib` size step runs in the Flutter app analyze job. `scripts/size_guard_selftest.sh` (new) proves rejection of oversized files in both dirs through both the CI scan and the pre-commit staged scan — ran: PASSED.
- **Barrel policy (cut #5)**: grouped append-only export sections with `// ── <subsystem> ──` headers, written into AGENTS.md alongside the ceiling/split-by-parts convention.
- Slash-command self-registration skipped: command tables already live in part files; the primary held none (noted in agent-cli split report).

### How to verify
```bash
bash scripts/size_guard_selftest.sh          # AC2: guard fires on bin/ + flutter_app/
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --scope all --stages size
dart test --concurrency=3 --exclude-tags integration   # 8863 passed, 0 failed
(cd flutter_app && flutter test test/agent_service test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart)
```
AC3 (touch-rate re-measure) is a metric for the next 40 PRs, not actionable in this change.

# gh-1232: [REFACTOR] CLI/app god-files at/over the 2800-line ceiling are the merge-conflict magnets — split bin/fah.dart, agent_cli.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_service.dart

## Description

**Data over the last 40 merged PRs** (2026-10-03/04, 369 file-touches): the highest-churn files are simultaneously the biggest files — classic god-file conflict physics:

| file | PRs touching it | current lines | vs 2800 guard |
|---|---|---|---|
| lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart | **11 (27.5%)** | 2737 | 63 under |
| bin/fah.dart | 6 | **2826** | **OVER** |
| .github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml | 6 | — | — |
| lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart (barrel) | 5 | 260 | — |
| lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart + agent_cli_config.dart | 5+5 | 1541/783 | — |
| lib/src/tools/builtin_tools.dart | 4 | **2799** | **1 under** |
| flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart | 4 | **2815** | **OVER** |

Every fourth PR fights over agent_cli.dart; every long-lived PR (30–65h lead: #1143 65h, #1163 55h, #1165 55h, #1161/#1166/#1173 49h) must rebase across the serial main queue through these same files. Size and churn compound: the bigger the file, the higher the probability two PRs edit adjacent regions.

**Also suspicious**: bin/fah.dart (2826) and agent_service.dart (2815) are OVER the pre-commit 2800-line guard yet keep landing — verify the guard actually covers them (exempt-list hole?).

**Proposed cuts:**
1. **bin/fah.dart → bin/thin + lib/src/cli/fah_commands/**: one file per subcommand family (trajectory/session/bench/…), main keeps arg routing only.
2. **agent_cli.dart**: it is already a part-of library (approval_commands etc.) — finish the pattern: slash-command tables self-register from part files so the main file stops being the edit magnet for every new command.
3. **agent_service.dart** split by concern: session lifecycle / provider wiring / secrets / mail fabric.
4. **builtin_tools.dart**: per-tool-family assembly files under lib/src/tools/.
5. **Barrel policy** (flutter_agent_harness.dart, 5/40 touches): grouped append-only export sections with a one-line convention comment, or per-subsystem mini-barrels — pick one, write it in AGENTS.md.

**Acceptance:**
- AC1: bin/fah.dart, agent_service.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_cli.dart each < 2000 lines after the split; zero behavior change (existing test suites green, no public API moves without deprecation).
- AC2: the pre-commit size guard demonstrably fires on a file > 2800 in bin/ and flutter_app/ (test: temporary oversized file → hook rejects).
- AC3: re-measure after the next 40 merged PRs: agent_cli.dart touch rate < 15%, no file above 2400 lines in the top-10 churn list.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  SHARED FAST GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL   ║
# ║  size ≤ 2800 lines · analyze · tests · coverage ≥ 80% · CRAP ratchet ·    ║
# ║  duplication < 1% (flutter_app < 3.7%) · cross-module < 0.31%             ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# THE shared fast gate used by BOTH the pre-commit hook and CI (issue #177,
# AC7). Both callers run this exact script and diff the one-line markers
#   GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>
# for hook/CI parity. Every known stage ALWAYS prints exactly one marker:
# OK when it ran and passed, SKIP <reason> when it was not selected or a
# required tool is missing. A failing stage aborts the script with exit 1
# BEFORE its OK marker is printed (marker absent = failed).
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh [--scope auto|all|core|app|docs] [--stages list] [--hook]
#
#   --scope auto  Derive the scope from changed paths (default):
#                 - in a git hook (--hook flag or GIT_INDEX_FILE set):
#                   staged files via `git diff --cached --name-only`;
#                 - in CI (BASE_REF + HEAD_REF env vars set):
#                   `git diff --name-only $BASE_REF...$HEAD_REF`;
#                 - otherwise: "all" (safe default).
#   --scope all   Run every stage.
#   --scope core  size + analyze + test-core + coverage + crap + dup + dupx.
#   --scope app   size + analyze + dup + dupx + flutter.
#   --scope docs  size + analyze only.
#   --stages l    Comma-separated stage list; overrides the scope-derived set.
#                 Known stages: size,analyze,test-core,coverage,crap,dup,dupx,flutter,integration-mock
#
#
# Path rules (union logic, E1; test/** counts as core, E6):
#   docs/ | *.md | prompts/ .................. size + analyze
#   lib/ | bin/ | test/ | pubspec.* .......... + test-core, coverage, crap, dup, dupx
#   test/integration/** ...................... + integration-mock (no-key legs,
#                                              MockLlmServer; issue #551)
#   flutter_app/ | packages/ ................. + dup, dupx, flutter
#   scripts/ | .github/ | crap4dart.yaml ..... ALL stages (safe default, E2)
#   anything unknown ......................... ALL stages (safe default)
#
# Concurrency overrides: FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY / FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY
# (auto-throttled via detect_test_concurrency, same as scripts/pre-commit).
# Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N makes the integration-mock
# stage rerun ONLY its failed files, up to N times, before failing — the
# load-sensitive PTY/grid timing legs stop costing a full 2.5 h leg per
# ambient flake (default 0 = single-shot, behaviour unchanged).
#
# CRAP ratchet scoping: in --hook mode the analyze runs over the STAGED
# lib/bin files only — the ratchet guards what a commit touches, so a
# pre-existing offender in an untouched file cannot block an unrelated
# commit. Non-hook runs (and ci.yml's whole-repo `crap4dart analyze`)
# keep the full-repo view, so nothing escapes the ratchet permanently.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Unset git env vars so test processes that spawn git subprocesses use the
# correct working directory rather than the hook's environment. The --hook
# scope detection below reads GIT_INDEX_FILE BEFORE this line runs.
SCOPE=auto
STAGES_OVERRIDE=""
HOOK_MODE=0
DRY_RUN=0
if [ "${GIT_INDEX_FILE:-}" ]; then HOOK_MODE=1; fi
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --scope) SCOPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --scope=*) SCOPE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --stages) STAGES_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --stages=*) STAGES_OVERRIDE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --hook) HOOK_MODE=1; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;   # print derived scope/stages, run nothing
    *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE 2>/dev/null || true

COVERAGE_BASELINE=80.0

5. **Barrel policy** (flutter_agent_harness.dart, 5/40 touches): grouped append-only export sections with a one-line convention comment, or per-subsystem mini-barrels — pick one, write it in AGENTS.md.

- AC1: bin/fah.dart, agent_service.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_cli.dart each < 2000 lines after the split; zero behavior change (existing test suites green, no public API moves without deprecation).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  SHARED FAST GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL   ║
# ║  size ≤ 2800 lines · analyze · tests · coverage ≥ 80% · CRAP ratchet ·    ║
# ║  duplication < 1% (flutter_app < 3.7%) · cross-module < 0.31%             ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# THE shared fast gate used by BOTH the pre-commit hook and CI (issue #177,
# AC7). Both callers run this exact script and diff the one-line markers
#   GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>
# for hook/CI parity. Every known stage ALWAYS prints exactly one marker:
# OK when it ran and passed, SKIP <reason> when it was not selected or a
# required tool is missing. A failing stage aborts the script with exit 1
# BEFORE its OK marker is printed (marker absent = failed).
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh [--scope auto|all|core|app|docs] [--stages list] [--hook]
#
#   --scope auto  Derive the scope from changed paths (default):
#                 - in a git hook (--hook flag or GIT_INDEX_FILE set):
#                   staged files via `git diff --cached --name-only`;
#                 - in CI (BASE_REF + HEAD_REF env vars set):
#                   `git diff --name-only $BASE_REF...$HEAD_REF`;
#                 - otherwise: "all" (safe default).
#   --scope all   Run every stage.
#   --scope core  size + analyze + test-core + coverage + crap + dup + dupx.
#   --scope app   size + analyze + dup + dupx + flutter.
#   --scope docs  size + analyze only.
#   --stages l    Comma-separated stage list; overrides the scope-derived set.
#                 Known stages: size,analyze,test-core,coverage,crap,dup,dupx,flutter,integration-mock
#
#
# Path rules (union logic, E1; test/** counts as core, E6):
#   docs/ | *.md | prompts/ .................. size + analyze
#   lib/ | bin/ | test/ | pubspec.* .......... + test-core, coverage, crap, dup, dupx
#   test/integration/** ...................... + integration-mock (no-key legs,
#                                              MockLlmServer; issue #551)
#   flutter_app/ | packages/ ................. + dup, dupx, flutter
#   scripts/ | .github/ | crap4dart.yaml ..... ALL stages (safe default, E2)
#   anything unknown ......................... ALL stages (safe default)
#
# Concurrency overrides: FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY / FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY
# (auto-throttled via detect_test_concurrency, same as scripts/pre-commit).
# Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N makes the integration-mock
# stage rerun ONLY its failed files, up to N times, before failing — the
# load-sensitive PTY/grid timing legs stop costing a full 2.5 h leg per
# ambient flake (default 0 = single-shot, behaviour unchanged).
#
# CRAP ratchet scoping: in --hook mode the analyze runs over the STAGED
# lib/bin files only — the ratchet guards what a commit touches, so a
# pre-existing offender in an untouched file cannot block an unrelated
# commit. Non-hook runs (and ci.yml's whole-repo `crap4dart analyze`)
# keep the full-repo view, so nothing escapes the ratchet permanently.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Unset git env vars so test processes that spawn git subprocesses use the
# correct working directory rather than the hook's environment. The --hook
# scope detection below reads GIT_INDEX_FILE BEFORE this line runs.
SCOPE=auto
STAGES_OVERRIDE=""
HOOK_MODE=0
DRY_RUN=0
if [ "${GIT_INDEX_FILE:-}" ]; then HOOK_MODE=1; fi
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --scope) SCOPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --scope=*) SCOPE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --stages) STAGES_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --stages=*) STAGES_OVERRIDE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --hook) HOOK_MODE=1; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;   # print derived scope/stages, run nothing
    *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE 2>/dev/null || true

COVERAGE_BASELINE=80.0

# Rework: fix red validation head (gh-1232 / PR #1236)

## Issues/Notes

- **Red root cause (blocking):** Validation CI went red on head `4a02fb8f` because `test/cli/approval_cli_test.dart` no longer compiled — `AgentCli.approvalPickerItemsForTest()` was undefined:
  ```text
  test/cli/approval_cli_test.dart:412:25: Error: The method 'approvalPickerItemsForTest' isn't defined for the type 'AgentCli'.
  test/cli/approval_cli_test.dart:439:12: Error: The method 'approvalPickerItemsForTest' isn't defined for the type 'AgentCli'.
  ```
  This failing leg took down `Static gates` (dart analyze), `Core tests (shard 1/4)`, `Hostile ambient env`, and the aggregate `Quality gate` — all from this single compile error. Failing CI run: `37215971900` (fetched via `gh run view --log-failed`; no other failing legs, no other failure causes).
- **Why it happened:** the merge of `main` into `ai/gh-1232` (at `4a02fb8f` / `76cf16da4`) dropped main's gh-1204 change (`38c7cb5a3`, "main red: /approval picker renders nothing") for the region that the branch had moved into the new part file `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_pickers.dart`. The merge kept the branch's pre-gh-1204 inline `_openApprovalPicker()` body, losing both the extracted `approvalPickerItems()` method and the `@visibleForTesting approvalPickerItemsForTest()` seam the gh-1204 test pins.
- No merge-conflict markers remain; size guard and all other gates verified clean locally (see Test Coverage).

## Approach

# gh-1232: [REFACTOR] CLI/app god-files at/over the 2800-line ceiling are the merge-conflict magnets — split bin/fah.dart, agent_cli.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_service.dart

## Description

**Data over the last 40 merged PRs** (2026-10-03/04, 369 file-touches): the highest-churn files are simultaneously the biggest files — classic god-file conflict physics:

| file | PRs touching it | current lines | vs 2800 guard |
|---|---|---|---|
| lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart | **11 (27.5%)** | 2737 | 63 under |
| bin/fah.dart | 6 | **2826** | **OVER** |
| .github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml | 6 | — | — |
| lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart (barrel) | 5 | 260 | — |
| lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart + agent_cli_config.dart | 5+5 | 1541/783 | — |
| lib/src/tools/builtin_tools.dart | 4 | **2799** | **1 under** |
| flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart | 4 | **2815** | **OVER** |

Every fourth PR fights over agent_cli.dart; every long-lived PR (30–65h lead: #1143 65h, #1163 55h, #1165 55h, #1161/#1166/#1173 49h) must rebase across the serial main queue through these same files. Size and churn compound: the bigger the file, the higher the probability two PRs edit adjacent regions.

**Also suspicious**: bin/fah.dart (2826) and agent_service.dart (2815) are OVER the pre-commit 2800-line guard yet keep landing — verify the guard actually covers them (exempt-list hole?).

**Proposed cuts:**
1. **bin/fah.dart → bin/thin + lib/src/cli/fah_commands/**: one file per subcommand family (trajectory/session/bench/…), main keeps arg routing only.
2. **agent_cli.dart**: it is already a part-of library (approval_commands etc.) — finish the pattern: slash-command tables self-register from part files so the main file stops being the edit magnet for every new command.
3. **agent_service.dart** split by concern: session lifecycle / provider wiring / secrets / mail fabric.
4. **builtin_tools.dart**: per-tool-family assembly files under lib/src/tools/.
5. **Barrel policy** (flutter_agent_harness.dart, 5/40 touches): grouped append-only export sections with a one-line convention comment, or per-subsystem mini-barrels — pick one, write it in AGENTS.md.

**Acceptance:**
- AC1: bin/fah.dart, agent_service.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_cli.dart each < 2000 lines after the split; zero behavior change (existing test suites green, no public API moves without deprecation).
- AC2: the pre-commit size guard demonstrably fires on a file > 2800 in bin/ and flutter_app/ (test: temporary oversized file → hook rejects).
- AC3: re-measure after the next 40 merged PRs: agent_cli.dart touch rate < 15%, no file above 2400 lines in the top-10 churn list.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  SHARED FAST GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL   ║
# ║  size ≤ 2800 lines · analyze · tests · coverage ≥ 80% · CRAP ratchet ·    ║
# ║  duplication < 1% (flutter_app < 3.7%) · cross-module < 0.31%             ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# THE shared fast gate used by BOTH the pre-commit hook and CI (issue #177,
# AC7). Both callers run this exact script and diff the one-line markers
#   GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>
# for hook/CI parity. Every known stage ALWAYS prints exactly one marker:
# OK when it ran and passed, SKIP <reason> when it was not selected or a
# required tool is missing. A failing stage aborts the script with exit 1
# BEFORE its OK marker is printed (marker absent = failed).
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh [--scope auto|all|core|app|docs] [--stages list] [--hook]
#
#   --scope auto  Derive the scope from changed paths (default):
#                 - in a git hook (--hook flag or GIT_INDEX_FILE set):
#                   staged files via `git diff --cached --name-only`;
#                 - in CI (BASE_REF + HEAD_REF env vars set):
#                   `git diff --name-only $BASE_REF...$HEAD_REF`;
#                 - otherwise: "all" (safe default).
#   --scope all   Run every stage.
#   --scope core  size + analyze + test-core + coverage + crap + dup + dupx.
#   --scope app   size + analyze + dup + dupx + flutter.
#   --scope docs  size + analyze only.
#   --stages l    Comma-separated stage list; overrides the scope-derived set.
#                 Known stages: size,analyze,test-core,coverage,crap,dup,dupx,flutter,integration-mock
#
#
# Path rules (union logic, E1; test/** counts as core, E6):
#   docs/ | *.md | prompts/ .................. size + analyze
#   lib/ | bin/ | test/ | pubspec.* .......... + test-core, coverage, crap, dup, dupx
#   test/integration/** ...................... + integration-mock (no-key legs,
#                                              MockLlmServer; issue #551)
#   flutter_app/ | packages/ ................. + dup, dupx, flutter
#   scripts/ | .github/ | crap4dart.yaml ..... ALL stages (safe default, E2)
#   anything unknown ......................... ALL stages (safe default)
#
# Concurrency overrides: FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY / FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY
# (auto-throttled via detect_test_concurrency, same as scripts/pre-commit).
# Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N makes the integration-mock
# stage rerun ONLY its failed files, up to N times, before failing — the
# load-sensitive PTY/grid timing legs stop costing a full 2.5 h leg per
# ambient flake (default 0 = single-shot, behaviour unchanged).
#
# CRAP ratchet scoping: in --hook mode the analyze runs over the STAGED
# lib/bin files only — the ratchet guards what a commit touches, so a
# pre-existing offender in an untouched file cannot block an unrelated
# commit. Non-hook runs (and ci.yml's whole-repo `crap4dart analyze`)
# keep the full-repo view, so nothing escapes the ratchet permanently.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Unset git env vars so test processes that spawn git subprocesses use the
# correct working directory rather than the hook's environment. The --hook
# scope detection below reads GIT_INDEX_FILE BEFORE this line runs.
SCOPE=auto
STAGES_OVERRIDE=""
HOOK_MODE=0
DRY_RUN=0
if [ "${GIT_INDEX_FILE:-}" ]; then HOOK_MODE=1; fi
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --scope) SCOPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --scope=*) SCOPE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --stages) STAGES_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --stages=*) STAGES_OVERRIDE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --hook) HOOK_MODE=1; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;   # print derived scope/stages, run nothing
    *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE 2>/dev/null || true

COVERAGE_BASELINE=80.0

Split the four god-files into `part`-based libraries (pure mechanical moves, zero behavior change) and closed the 2800-line guard hole that let two files sail past the ceiling:

# gh-1232: [REFACTOR] CLI/app god-files at/over the 2800-line ceiling are the merge-conflict magnets — split bin/fah.dart, agent_cli.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_service.dart

## Description

**Data over the last 40 merged PRs** (2026-10-03/04, 369 file-touches): the highest-churn files are simultaneously the biggest files — classic god-file conflict physics:

| file | PRs touching it | current lines | vs 2800 guard |
|---|---|---|---|
| lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart | **11 (27.5%)** | 2737 | 63 under |
| bin/fah.dart | 6 | **2826** | **OVER** |
| .github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml | 6 | — | — |
| lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart (barrel) | 5 | 260 | — |
| lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart + agent_cli_config.dart | 5+5 | 1541/783 | — |
| lib/src/tools/builtin_tools.dart | 4 | **2799** | **1 under** |
| flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart | 4 | **2815** | **OVER** |

Every fourth PR fights over agent_cli.dart; every long-lived PR (30–65h lead: #1143 65h, #1163 55h, #1165 55h, #1161/#1166/#1173 49h) must rebase across the serial main queue through these same files. Size and churn compound: the bigger the file, the higher the probability two PRs edit adjacent regions.

**Also suspicious**: bin/fah.dart (2826) and agent_service.dart (2815) are OVER the pre-commit 2800-line guard yet keep landing — verify the guard actually covers them (exempt-list hole?).

**Proposed cuts:**
1. **bin/fah.dart → bin/thin + lib/src/cli/fah_commands/**: one file per subcommand family (trajectory/session/bench/…), main keeps arg routing only.
2. **agent_cli.dart**: it is already a part-of library (approval_commands etc.) — finish the pattern: slash-command tables self-register from part files so the main file stops being the edit magnet for every new command.
3. **agent_service.dart** split by concern: session lifecycle / provider wiring / secrets / mail fabric.
4. **builtin_tools.dart**: per-tool-family assembly files under lib/src/tools/.
5. **Barrel policy** (flutter_agent_harness.dart, 5/40 touches): grouped append-only export sections with a one-line convention comment, or per-subsystem mini-barrels — pick one, write it in AGENTS.md.

**Acceptance:**
- AC1: bin/fah.dart, agent_service.dart, builtin_tools.dart, agent_cli.dart each < 2000 lines after the split; zero behavior change (existing test suites green, no public API moves without deprecation).
- AC2: the pre-commit size guard demonstrably fires on a file > 2800 in bin/ and flutter_app/ (test: temporary oversized file → hook rejects).
- AC3: re-measure after the next 40 merged PRs: agent_cli.dart touch rate < 15%, no file above 2400 lines in the top-10 churn list.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  SHARED FAST GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL   ║
# ║  size ≤ 2800 lines · analyze · tests · coverage ≥ 80% · CRAP ratchet ·    ║
# ║  duplication < 1% (flutter_app < 3.7%) · cross-module < 0.31%             ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# THE shared fast gate used by BOTH the pre-commit hook and CI (issue #177,
# AC7). Both callers run this exact script and diff the one-line markers
#   GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>
# for hook/CI parity. Every known stage ALWAYS prints exactly one marker:
# OK when it ran and passed, SKIP <reason> when it was not selected or a
# required tool is missing. A failing stage aborts the script with exit 1
# BEFORE its OK marker is printed (marker absent = failed).
#
# Usage:
#   scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh [--scope auto|all|core|app|docs] [--stages list] [--hook]
#
#   --scope auto  Derive the scope from changed paths (default):
#                 - in a git hook (--hook flag or GIT_INDEX_FILE set):
#                   staged files via `git diff --cached --name-only`;
#                 - in CI (BASE_REF + HEAD_REF env vars set):
#                   `git diff --name-only $BASE_REF...$HEAD_REF`;
#                 - otherwise: "all" (safe default).
#   --scope all   Run every stage.
#   --scope core  size + analyze + test-core + coverage + crap + dup + dupx.
#   --scope app   size + analyze + dup + dupx + flutter.
#   --scope docs  size + analyze only.
#   --stages l    Comma-separated stage list; overrides the scope-derived set.
#                 Known stages: size,analyze,test-core,coverage,crap,dup,dupx,flutter,integration-mock
#
#
# Path rules (union logic, E1; test/** counts as core, E6):
#   docs/ | *.md | prompts/ .................. size + analyze
#   lib/ | bin/ | test/ | pubspec.* .......... + test-core, coverage, crap, dup, dupx
#   test/integration/** ...................... + integration-mock (no-key legs,
#                                              MockLlmServer; issue #551)
#   flutter_app/ | packages/ ................. + dup, dupx, flutter
#   scripts/ | .github/ | crap4dart.yaml ..... ALL stages (safe default, E2)
#   anything unknown ......................... ALL stages (safe default)
#
# Concurrency overrides: FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY / FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY
# (auto-throttled via detect_test_concurrency, same as scripts/pre-commit).
# Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N makes the integration-mock
# stage rerun ONLY its failed files, up to N times, before failing — the
# load-sensitive PTY/grid timing legs stop costing a full 2.5 h leg per
# ambient flake (default 0 = single-shot, behaviour unchanged).
#
# CRAP ratchet scoping: in --hook mode the analyze runs over the STAGED
# lib/bin files only — the ratchet guards what a commit touches, so a
# pre-existing offender in an untouched file cannot block an unrelated
# commit. Non-hook runs (and ci.yml's whole-repo `crap4dart analyze`)
# keep the full-repo view, so nothing escapes the ratchet permanently.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Unset git env vars so test processes that spawn git subprocesses use the
# correct working directory rather than the hook's environment. The --hook
# scope detection below reads GIT_INDEX_FILE BEFORE this line runs.
SCOPE=auto
STAGES_OVERRIDE=""
HOOK_MODE=0
DRY_RUN=0
if [ "${GIT_INDEX_FILE:-}" ]; then HOOK_MODE=1; fi
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --scope) SCOPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --scope=*) SCOPE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --stages) STAGES_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --stages=*) STAGES_OVERRIDE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --hook) HOOK_MODE=1; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;   # print derived scope/stages, run nothing
    *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE 2>/dev/null || true

COVERAGE_BASELINE=80.0
